title: Replace Workflow section with Referral Program section

requirements.summary: Remove WorkflowSection from App.tsx and replace with ReferralProgramSection component
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowSection component is no longer rendered in App.tsx
ReferralProgramSection component is imported and rendered in its place
The new section appears in the correct position in the page flow

file_operations.description: Remove the WorkflowSection import and component usage from the main application composition. Import the new ReferralProgramSection component and render it in the same position where WorkflowSection was previously located (between TargetClientsSection and PilotProgramSection). Maintain the existing section order and ensure proper component composition.

requirements.summary: Create ReferralProgramSection component displaying commission structure and program details in Spanish
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays 'Programa de Referencias' as the section heading
Shows commission range of 15-30% for first contract obtained
Clearly states 15% of net value from first collected contract
Explains payment occurs after receiving full client payment
Specifies transfer within 30 days after collection
All text is in Spanish with proper grammar and accent marks
Visual design is consistent with other sections (cybersecurity theme, proper spacing, typography)

file_operations.description: Create a new React functional component that displays the referral program information. Include a section heading 'Programa de Referencias' using typography consistent with other sections (likely h2 with appropriate Tailwind classes). Present the commission structure details: 15-30% commission range for first contract obtained, 15% of net value from first collected contract, payment after receiving full client payment, and transfer within 30 days after collection. Use Spanish text throughout with proper accent marks (comisión, después, días). Apply the cybersecurity design theme using the existing color palette (primary, secondary colors from CSS variables) and maintain consistent spacing, padding, and typography patterns found in ServicesSection and TargetClientsSection.

requirements.summary: Structure ReferralProgramSection with prominent commission details using card/grid layout with partnership-themed visual elements
acceptanceCriteria: Commission structure is presented in an easy-to-scan format (cards, list, or grid)
Visual hierarchy emphasizes the key benefit (15-30% commission)
Includes appropriate icons or visual elements
Layout is responsive and matches the design pattern of ServicesSection or TargetClientsSection

file_operations.description: Enhance the ReferralProgramSection component layout to use a card-based or grid layout pattern similar to ServicesSection (which uses a grid of four service cards). Structure the commission details in an easy-to-scan format using individual cards or list items for each commission point. Emphasize the 15-30% commission benefit with larger text, bold styling, or prominent placement. Add appropriate icons from lucide-react (such as Users, Handshake, DollarSign, TrendingUp, or Clock) that convey partnership and financial benefits. Ensure the layout is fully responsive using Tailwind's responsive utilities (sm:, md:, lg: breakpoints) and matches the spacing, card styling, and visual hierarchy patterns established in other sections. Use rounded corners, subtle shadows or borders, and proper padding consistent with the cybersecurity design theme.
